storyCards.headline: Heartless: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Fray's "Heartless" reached #79 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Heartless" is a song by American rapper Kanye West from his fourth studio album, 808s & Heartbreak (2008).

The song peaked at #79 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 1 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "Through The Years: The Best Of The Fray" (2016) — not the song's original release year.

Album: Through The Years: The Best Of The Fray (2016).

Chart story — peaked at #79 on the Hot 100.
